elements.name: line-midpoint-09 Create a full-length numeric segment symmetric about the origin

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/empty-planar-sketch-right.opd` is open with Sketch1 active in Right view and Ready with Snap to Grid disabled
the user invoke Midpoint Line and choose the sketch origin as midpoint
the user press 1 and then 0 in the length field
the user press Tab
length 10.000 mm is locked and the angle field is selected
the user press 3 and then 0 in the angle field
the user press Return
the command requests another midpoint
the user press Escape
the segment remains with 10 mm and 30.00-degree annotations
the sketch reports Fully Constrained in this fixture
the user open Measure and select the segment away from its midpoint
the curve length is 10.000 mm
the user click empty canvas to clear the selection
the user select both endpoints
their distance is 10.000 mm
their displayed coordinate differences are (0.000, 8.660, 5.000) mm
their average equals the chosen origin within displayed precision
the user click empty canvas to clear the endpoint pair
the user select the origin
Measure reports Point (0.000, 0.000, 0.000) mm
